prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a modern black security camera mounted on the exterior wall of a house, painted in a vibrant sky blue. The camera is positioned slightly off-center to the right, its sleek, rounded design contrasting with the vertical wooden planks of the wall. Soft, natural light casts a gentle, crescent-shaped shadow across the blue surface, adding depth and visual interest. The background is out of focus, revealing the dimly lit interior of the house through an open doorway, with only vague shapes and a hint of a picture frame visible, emphasizing the separation between inside and outside. The color palette is dominated by cool blues and muted grays, creating a calm, slightly mysterious atmosphere. The composition is minimalist, with a shallow depth of field and a cinematic, almost voyeuristic quality, as if the viewer is quietly observing a moment of stillness and quiet surveillance.
